jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (NLP/Llms)
jobs.why: Great domain fit in Riyadh, but requires MSc/PhD and 5+ years ML/NLP experience.

jd.text:
About The Role



We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in
Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to join our growing team. This role requires strong research-to-production skills, combined with robust software engineering capabilities to ensure scalable, reliable systems.



Key Responsibilities





- Design, develop, and deploy NLP and LLM-based solutions for real-world applications.
- Translate research papers and experimental models into production-ready systems.
- Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines, ensuring performance and reliability.
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate ML models into Hudhud’s platforms.
- Conduct experiments, evaluate models, and optimize for accuracy, efficiency, and cost.
- Stay up to date with the latest advancements in NLP, LLMs, and generative AI.
- Guide junior engineers and contribute to building a high-performance AI team.





Qualifications & Skills




- Education: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields.
- Experience: Minimum 5+ years of professional experience in ML/NLP, with at least 3+ years working on LLMs.
- Core Expertise:

- Strong background in NLP techniques (transformers, embeddings, sequence models).
- Hands-on experience with LLMs (fine-tuning, prompt engineering, model evaluation).
- Practical experience with LangChain and/or Haystack frameworks for building LLM-powered applications.
- Solid understanding of ML system design and deployment in production environments.



- Software Engineering Skills:

- Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face).
- Strong knowledge of software engineering principles (version control, testing, CI/CD).
- Experience with distributed systems, APIs, and microservices.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
- Preferred: Experience in Arabic NLP or multilingual LLMs is a strong plus.





Joining Hudhud Means





- Working on real-world problems with direct impact across industries in Saudi Arabia and beyond.
- Being part of a fast-growing startup that values innovation, ownership, and bold ideas.
- Collaborating with a team passionate about pushing the boundaries of geospatial technology.
- Helping shape the future of customer experience through maps and location intelligence.





We’re not just building technology — we’re redefining how people and businesses experience the world around them.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.why: Strong fit for Riyadh-based agentic AI, LLMs, RAG, and n8n product engineering. (capped: 1 verified requirement gaps)
blockers: Missing Required Degree in CS or Related Discipline

jd.text:
ABOUT CONSULUM

Consulum are the leading intelligence-led strategy and communications firm. We design and activate evidence-led programmes to deliver targeted outcomes for governments and businesses. Rooted in the MENA region and powered by the Stagwell Global Network, we bring deep insight, cutting-edge tools, and creative firepower to every challenge.

We combine unrivalled experience with proprietary research capabilities to generate the clarity leaders need to cut through complexity, act with precision, and deliver meaningful impact. Our vision is to set the global benchmark for how strategy and communications is used to deliver real-world outcomes.

As part of a global network, we are linked to more than 13,000 colleagues across 40+ countries, each bringing expertise in communications, research, digital, advertising, transformation, and AI-powered tools. This connection gives us additional tools, insights, and capability to set the industry standard.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Consulum is seeking an entrepreneurial Forward Deployed AI Engineer to work at the

intersection of AI engineering, product ownership, consulting and client delivery. The role

translates client and internal business challenges into secure, practical and scalable agentic AI products, and owns solutions from initial discovery and product definition through prototyping, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement. Beyond individual client work, the role helps shape Consulum's emerging AI product portfolio by identifying repeatable use cases, developing reusable components and turning successful client solutions into scalable products and offerings.

LOCATION

Riyadh, Saudia Arabia, with travel to client sites as required

REPORTING TO : Head of AI.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Work directly with consulting teams, clients and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, user needs and opportunities for AI-enabled products.
Own assigned AI solutions across the product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, prototyping, testing, deployment, and adoption.
Translate open-ended business problems into clear product requirements, user stories, technical specifications and delivery roadmaps.
Design, build and deploy agentic AI applications using LLMs, RAG, workflow automation tools such as n8n, APIs and client data sources.
Support client demonstrations, workshops, pilots, implementation, documentation, training and adoption, including presentations to senior government stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to convert bespoke client solutions into reusable modules, accelerators and scalable Consulum products.
Work with the Head of AI to shape product roadmaps, prioritise new capabilities and evaluate technical and commercial opportunities;
Maintain strong standards around security, data privacy, AI governance, evaluation and production reliability.

SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES

 Essential Skills

Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in software engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence or a related discipline.
AI & Technical Capability: hands-on experience building and deploying AI solutions using Python, LLMs, RAG, APIs, agentic workflows, and automation tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, n8n or equivalent platforms. Skilled in prompt engineering and AI evaluation; quick to learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies.
Product Ownership: proven end – to- end ownership of a digital or AI solution from discovery and requirements through prototyping, testing, deployment, adoption and post-launch iteration — including at least one product taken from concept to successful delivery.
Problem Solving: strong structured and logical thinking; able to translate ambiguous client or business challenges into practical, scalable AI solutions and clear technical requirements. Entrepreneurial product mindset balancing user needs, feasibility, and commercial value while moving quickly from ambiguity to action, and experimenting with emerging AI.
Client Delivery & Communication: confident working directly with clients and senior stakeholders; able to demonstrate solutions, facilitate workshops and explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Project & Stakeholder Management: ability to structure and manage AI projects, coordinate with consulting teams, technical stakeholders and clients, and deliver effectively against agreed priorities and timelines.
Language: Excellent written and spoken business English and Arabic

 Preferred skills

Experience working with Saudi government or enterprise clients
Between 1–3 years of experience building software, automation, data or applied AI solutions.

 Attributes

Leadership: the ability to develop relationships of influence with clients and colleagues.
Can-do: being resourceful, proactive, positive and problem-solving.
Resilience and stamina: the ability to handle diverse clients and a demanding workload
Development-orientation: curiosity and the desire to learn, grow and progress

OUR VALUES

Our values drive our culture. We want every person at Consulum to make an impact, to grow and to be surrounded by people they respect and admire.

Solve What Matters

We solve the right problem, not just the brief.

Challenge With Purpose

Intelligent, constructive challenge — for clients and ourselves.

Build Together

One team, shared development, collective wins.

WHY JOIN CONSULUM

Work for a purpose-driven organisation seeking to improve the positive performance and impact of corporates and governments.
Be part of a high-performance culture defined by the pursuit of excellence, collaboration and a focus on professional development.
Contribute to the development of the business.
Progress with a clear and achievable path to promotion.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.why: Full-stack software role centered around Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq, and a CS degree.

jd.text:
We are looking for a Software Engineer – Full Stack to join Moyasar’s Engineering team and contribute to building and improving our payment products and systems.
You will work across the full application stack, with Ruby on Rails as our core framework, developing backend services, APIs, web applications, and user-facing features. You will work with technologies including Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Sidekiq to build reliable and scalable solutions.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving problems, writing clean and maintainable code, and collaborating with other engineers, Product, and Design to deliver high-quality features.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications and features across Moyasar’s products. 
Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Ruby on Rails. 
Develop and improve frontend features and user-facing web applications. 
Design, build, maintain, and integrate RESTful APIs. 
Work with PostgreSQL to design data models and write efficient database queries. 
Use Redis and Sidekiq for caching, background processing, and asynchronous jobs. 
Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code. 
Write and maintain automated tests, including unit and integration tests. 
Participate actively in code reviews and technical discussions. 
Troubleshoot and resolve bugs, application issues, and performance problems. 
Contribute to improving application performance, reliability, scalability, and security. 
Collaborate with Product, Design, and other engineers to understand requirements and deliver new features. 
Participate in technical planning, estimation, and Agile development processes. 
Document technical processes, system changes, and important development decisions. 
Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards and development practices. 
Stay current with relevant technologies and software engineering practices.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
2+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
Professional experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails. 
Experience developing full-stack web applications. 
Good understanding of MVC architecture and software engineering principles. 
Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs. 
Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and relational database concepts. 
Experience with Redis. 
Experience with background job processing using Sidekiq. 
Experience with frontend web development. 
Experience with Git and version-control workflows. 
Experience writing automated tests. 
Good understanding of clean code principles and maintainable software architecture. 
Understanding of application performance, scalability, and security. 
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
Good communication and collaboration skills. 
Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical team members. 
Good command of English. 
Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or high-volume transactional systems is a plus.
